answer: Proof of Personhood protocols utilize biometric entropy to gate access, effectively creating a gale of validation that blows away fraudulent accounts. Much like a single ember struggling to ignite within a vast nebula, an attacker faces a prohibitive cost: they must secure unique physical verification for each identity, rendering large-scale Sybil attacks economically unfeasible due to the linear scaling of acquisition costs compared to the stagnant value of forged identities.
